title: Warped cones associated to isometric free actions do not have geometric property (T)
summary: Suppose that $G$ is a finitely generated group, $M$ is a compact Riemannian manifold and $G\curvearrowright M$ is a free and isometric action. We prove that the associated discretized warped cone does not have geometric property (T). In contrast, we show that the discretized warped cone associated to the natural action $SL_m(\mathbb Z)\curvearrowright \mathbb T^m$ has geometric property (T) for $m\geq 3$.
